lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition H2N2O4 (reduced formula HNO2) crystallizes in the triclinic space group P-1 (No. 2), with eight atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies a tetrahedral N center with three H and one O neighbor, plus an octahedral O center coordinated by four H and two N atoms. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between N-centered tetrahedra and O-centered octahedra, plus edge-sharing among the octahedra.
